## 2026-01-11 - ASCII Charts for CLI Reports
**Learning:** Adding simple ASCII bar charts (e.g., `█████░░░░░`) to Markdown reports generated by CLI tools dramatically improves data readability without requiring external libraries or complex rendering. Users can instantly grasp distributions (like "Top Categories" or "Top Domains") that are otherwise just lists of numbers.
**Action:** When working on CLI-generated reports in the future, standardizing on a helper function `draw_bar(count, max, width)` is a high-value, low-cost UX pattern.
